claim: Whether the data is distributed in a disk-based NoSQL database or vertically scaled up in a relational database, scaling for extremely high reads can be costly and may require a number of database read replicas to match what a single in-memory cache node can deliver in requests per second.

values.display: a single in-memory cache node can deliver

evidence.quote: Cost to scale: Whether the data is distributed in a disk-based NoSQL database or vertically scaled up in a relational database, scaling for extremely high reads can be costly and may require a number of database read-replicas to match what a single in-memory cache node can deliver in terms of requests per second.

note: Quote moved from the historical Redis whitepaper to the AWS caching page, which states the same point in one sentence.
